blind_spots_patched: Original Chapters 1-6 omitted promoter ownership concentration, promoter share pledges, recent executive insider disposals, and non-wholly-owned JV/subsidiary capital structure (KRKA Pharma 49% JV and Eight Roads/F-Prime external equity in Laurus Bio).

Original Chapters 1-6 treated PEPFAR/Global Fund ARV tenders (33.2% of H1 FY27 revenue) as predictable baseload and assumed an unchallenged China+1 CDMO tailwind, omitting 2025-2026 US foreign-assistance/PEPFAR funding disruptions and 2026 US Section 232 pharmaceutical tariffs.

Original Chapters 1-6 compared Laurus only against Divi's Laboratories and Dishman Carbogen Amcis, omitting PE-backed/consolidated Indian CDMO rivals (Cohance/Suven merged May 2025, Sai Life Sciences, Neuland, Syngene, Piramal) and Chinese CDMO competition (WuXi AppTec).
assumptions_changed: CONFIRMED: CDMO reached 41.9% of H1 FY27 revenue (Rs 1,774 Cr, +71% YoY), FY26 consolidated sales were Rs 6,813 Cr (+23% YoY), ARV declined to 33.2% of H1 FY27, and management guides gross margins >60% and EBITDA margins >30%.
CONFIRMED: USFDA compliance remains clean across flagship sites (Hyderabad API zero Form 483s in Sep 2024; Vizag Unit-4 EIR in Apr 2025) with zero new OAI or Warning Letter actions.
WEAKENED: Capex of ~Rs 3,000 Cr across FY27-FY28 represents a finite construction wave after which free cash flow should normalize as CWIP (Rs 1,282 Cr) converts to revenue.
WEAKENED: FY26 FCF inflection to Rs 560 Cr (CFO Rs 1,624 Cr) marks a durable step-up in multi-year free cash flow conversion.
